How we report

  • When a milestone is reached or missed, this file is updated and a short note goes in the conversation: hit or missed, by how much, and why.
  • Agents can read the same roadmap from dayonegreat.com/api/status or the MCP tool get_status.
  • "Done" means every check for that milestone in ACCEPTANCE.md passes.

Source: ROADMAP.md, last updated October 29, 2026. Every row, generated from the file before each commit; each result’s pill is read from the result’s first words, which are printed under it.
